geometry_scope_note: Potential full-ring overlap and interior collision candidates do not prove loaded thread engagement
yaw_scope_note: Raw female-frame yaw during initially perpendicular axes and block acquisition/reorientation is not a screw angle. Lead qualification applies only to named aligned closed strokes after capture; prealignment table-pickup phases have no lead residual.

recorded_metadata.description: Actual YAM picks up both free workpieces from declared table/rest support, carries them, and starts the M8 thread
recorded_metadata.left_acquisition_reference_scope: Frozen at end of settle_left_block after actual bilateral loaded pad contact
recorded_metadata.engagement_observer_scope: Candidate full-flank capture; actual coupled lead and unsupported reset checks establish completed engagement
recorded_metadata.legacy_engagement_note: Consecutive positive force for 0.2 s retained as a diagnostic; unilateral contact may have valid resolved gaps
recorded_metadata.axial_command_note: Known bolt-weight compensation plus constant net axial feed, with declared dissipative relative hand/hole velocity damping through finite native arm motors; no axial position or pitch spring
recorded_metadata.axial_velocity_reference_note: Actual hand SITE linear velocity minus hole rigid-frame velocity evaluated at the hand point; pre-command native kinematics retained from the preceding mj_step's pre-integration state (the initialized state on the first command), with requested feed subject to the existing Cartesian-force and native motor-torque caps
recorded_metadata.entry_support_note: Optional bounded constant-force entry/starting-stop dwell requires settled actual bolt velocity and measured native SDF-pair load before rotation or searching release; cone support is separate from formed-flank capture, and acquisition timeout retains the closed grasp

recorded_metadata.reported_sdf_depth_note: Native contact dist proxy; not an independent overlap certificate

archived_model_identity.method: Exact hash-verified archived XML; current scene generator is not used

table_block_pickup_audit.scope: Saved-pose geometry samples only. Initial/pre-lift table contact is expected; after lift all block world candidates are prohibited. Original all-substep loads, initial diagnostics and motor-only checks remain rollout evidence.

inspected_controller_source.inspection_method: Static exact function blocks and archived helper sources; controller code is not executed

right_retention_scope_note: First reference is end of pickup settle; intentional opening clears it, and each loaded regrasp establishes its own reference. Open hand motion is not classified as grip slip.
sampled_left_pad_depth_scope: Native signed contact depth recomputed from saved post-integration poses. It is a sampled collision penetration diagnostic, not an every-substep deformation certificate or a calibrated pad material model. Nonpad hand/block candidates include the actual native backing geometry.

left_pad_force_history_audit.kind: Original every-substep pad-force diagnostic consistency audit
left_pad_force_history_audit.method: Raw-array identity, timestep coverage and independent aggregation only; zero integration or force solve
left_pad_force_history_audit.force_scope: Normal loads originate from the recorded native contact solve. Reaggregation does not independently establish contact-law accuracy or reconstruct forces from saved poses.
left_pad_force_history_audit.timing: mj_step contact forces and contact geometry are from the pre-integration state at recorded time minus timestep; saved qpos/qvel are the post-integration state

left_pad_force_history_audit.coverage_note: Force evaluation is at recorded time minus timestep; saved qpos/qvel are post-integration. Coverage runs from the acquisition step through the final step; initial ungrasped phases are outside this retention scope.

capture_observer_audit.scope: The window declares candidate full-flank capture. Completed engagement additionally requires coupled metric lead, actual contact torque, and unsupported unseated open resets.
capture_observer_audit.force_scope: Resolved interior-contact normal impulse is not axial impulse or axial load balance. Rolling diagnostics originate from every-substep instrumentation; sampled qpos cannot independently reconstruct them.

passive_self_locking_during_open_reset.scope: All-substep maximum yaw/axial drift only after declared formed-flank engagement; starting-cone resets are reported separately

force_scope_note: Original loaded-contact and between-sample force/support checks remain the rollout's evidence; this audit performs zero integration or force solve

compaction.note: Saved-pose replay cannot reconstruct original all-substep normal impulses or support forces
